issuer_name: Procaps Group, S.A. (parent of Sofgen Pharma S.A.)
no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Procaps Group is an integrated softgel Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO) and producer of generics, OTC, and nutraceutical products distributed to 50+ countries. Sofgen Pharma is its US-based softgel CDMO business unit. The company is not a clinical-stage drug developer; it manufactures third-party products and its own generic/OTC catalog. No proprietary novel-drug P1/P2/P3 trials. PRCWF is the warrant ticker; common stock trades as PROC.
